def compute_skewness(data, stride, n):
    data = np.array(data, dtype=np.double)
    data_ptr = data.ctypes.data_as(ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_double))
    skewness_func = gsl.gsl_stats_skew
    skewness_func.argtypes = [ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_double), ctypes.c_size_t, ctypes.c_size_t]
    skewness_func.restype = ctypes.c_double
    return skewness_func(data_ptr, stride, n)
